name: megascenes-birthday-card
description: Design birthday cards with the name, your message and your signature in the design, in the look you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give who the card is for, the greeting, a short message and how you sign it, and pick the look: elegant gold, balloons and confetti, floral watercolor, a funny cartoon, minimal. You get a birthday card with your words set in the design, portrait, square or wide, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For friends, family, coworkers and milestone birthdays.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards or keep a list of birthdays. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set the name, message and signature in the design
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: An elegant gold birthday card for Anna that says Happy Birthday, signed Love, Marco
A funny cartoon birthday card for my coworker Sam: Another year wiser
A floral watercolor birthday card with the words Wishing you the best year yet

positive.prompt: An elegant gold birthday card for Anna that says Happy Birthday, signed Love, Marco. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one birthday card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A funny cartoon birthday card for my coworker Sam that says Another year wiser. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a birthday card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The birthday card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A floral watercolor birthday card, square, with the words Wishing you the best year yet. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my birthday card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my birthday card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
